title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.8 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It adds the non-admissive Audit Return Desk, matching Python and browser checks, a deterministic five-file Custom GPT Knowledge package, and a 12-case compact-profile Preview policy. The public GPT produces bounded human-readable audits and does not generate downloadable machine records, compiler output, hashes, Base64, shards, parity, transport, or section 10. The repository preserves the artifact compiler, controller, and historical 39-case transport evaluation as supervised standalone tooling and evidence; those components separate candidate failure, invalid-controller trials, and unresolved transport identity without granting proof or deployment authority. The package adds no Action or verification API. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input.
